# DeskLayer Community Plugins

Plugins shared by the community on the [DeskLayer forum](https://bbs.byteplayer.app).

**Do not edit files here by hand.** This directory is generated by
`.github/workflows/bridge.yml`, which runs every 6 hours (or on manual
dispatch) and:

1. Reads topics tagged **`verified`** in the forum's **Plugin Showcase**
   category (the tag is staff-only — a moderator reviews the plugin source
   before tagging).
2. Parses the topic template (plugin name, version, description, download
   URL, preview image, required permissions).
3. Downloads the `.js` (1 MB cap, allowlisted hosts only), checks that it
   contains `plugin.export` and parses cleanly (static check — never
   executed), and vendors it under `plugins/<slug>-<version>.js` so the
   reviewed bytes are pinned. A new plugin version requires a new review.
4. Regenerates `catalog.json` (same schema as the official store), sorted by
   forum cheers. Each description links back to the forum topic.

## Using this store in DeskLayer

Add a plugin store with either URL:

- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qiudaomao/DeskLayerPluginStore/main/community/catalog.json`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/qiudaomao/DeskLayerPluginStore@main/community/catalog.json` (CDN mirror)

## Sharing your plugin

Post it in the forum's **Plugin Showcase** category using the topic template.
Once a moderator verifies it, it appears here automatically.
